audit.whatIsWrong: The entire full layer calls Zoe 'he/his/him' — tldr, winCon, tradeGood, tradeBad, four phases whys, breakdown.trading, breakdown.wave, three dosFull titles, dontsFull titles and bodies, and report entries 0, 1, 3, 4, 9 and 11. The content layer correctly uses 'she'.
audit.why: champ-gender.js lists Zoe as female, and the reader is addressed as 'you', so every third-person pronoun on the page refers to her. This is defect-catalogue item 1 — a template written for a male enemy with only the name swapped.
audit.corrected: All misgendered writable fields swapped to she/her. The swaps are length-neutral (his -> her) or one character longer (he -> she), so every field stays inside the band.

audit.whatIsWrong: spikes[1].text says 'Zoe has no true mobility beyond her W (Spell Thief) portals'. W is not a portal and is not her mobility.
audit.why: Kit: Spell Thief (W, 0.25s) picks up the remnants of enemy summoner-spell and active-item casts and lets her cast one herself. Portal Jump (R, 11/8/5s, 575) is the blink — out for 1 second, then back. Sleepy Trouble Bubble (E, 18/17/16/15/14s, 800) reduces the target's MR while asleep and the first source of damage that breaks the sleep is doubled up to a cap. breakdown.cooldowns held no number at all, and dosFull[2].d invented a 'fifteen-second' cooldown that appears nowhere in either kit.
audit.corrected: spikes[1].text now names Portal Jump as the 1-second blink out and back; breakdown.cooldowns rebuilt on E 18s->14s, Q 8.5s->6.5s, R down to 5s and your own 9s E; dosFull[0].d states the real sleep mechanic (MR cut, doubled wake-up hit) as the reason the ball rides on you.

audit.whatIsWrong: Full layer chart reads Zoe/Skill x6; content and packet read Orianna/Skill/Skill/Zoe/Skill/Skill/Orianna. Rows 0, 3 and 6 disagree.
audit.why: Level 1 is Orianna's before the bubble is leveled; 4-5 is Zoe's once E plus a charged Q is a two-cast kill pattern; the last row is Orianna's because Shockwave is multi-target and Zoe hunts one pick.
audit.corrected: phases[0].side -> Orianna, phases[3].side -> Zoe with the why rewritten to the 18s bubble and the doubled wake-up hit, phases[6].side -> Orianna.

audit.whatIsWrong: phases[5].why claimed 'Q-W chunks a third of his bar' — a magnitude with no source — and phases[4].why claimed your presence doubles at 6 without mentioning her ult at all.
audit.why: Defect-catalogue item 6. Portal Jump at 6 is a dodge, not an escape (1 second out and back), which is exactly what makes the row even rather than a doubling of your threat.
audit.corrected: Row 4 states Portal Jump's real behaviour; row 5 replaces the invented fraction with her Q's straight-line damage ramp.

audit.whatIsWrong: No cooldown numbers anywhere in the full layer, and one fabricated one ('fifteen-second invitation').
audit.corrected: The sequencing is now explicit: a missed bubble buys you 18 seconds at rank 1, and that is the window for the whole Q-W-auto rotation.

notes: This matchup carried the pronoun defect end to end: the whole full layer addressed Zoe as 'he', while the content layer had her right — the same page contradicted itself on the enemy's gender. spikes[1] also identified Spell Thief (W) as her mobility; Portal Jump (R) is the blink, and W is the summoner-spell pickup. Of the three supplied missingInteractions, the terrain one was not written: Riot's text for Sleepy Trouble Bubble describes drowsiness and sleep, with no wall or path-blocking component, so the 'terrain' flag looks like a tooltip-parse misfire and 'she can cut your retreat' was not asserted. The 'trueDamage' flag is likewise absent from the description — the real mechanic (MR reduction while asleep, doubled first hit) was used instead. phases[N].rating untouched.
